```yamlfile
name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:

jobs:
  meson-build-and-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    name: ubuntu-22.04, clang debug
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        flavor:
          - debug
        mode:
          - name: clang
            args: -Dtests=enabled
            extra_envs:
              CC: clang
              CXX: clang++
        platform:
          - ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - name: Setup meson
        run: |
          pipx install meson ninja
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Configuring
        env:
          CC: clang
          CXX: clang++
        run: |
          meson setup build-debug --buildtype=debug -Dtests=enabled
      - name: Building
        run: |
          meson compile -C build-debug
      - name: Running tests
        env:
          CC: clang
          CXX: clang++
        run: |
          meson test -C build-debug --timeout-multiplier 0
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: failure()
        with:
          name: ubuntu-22.04-clang-debug-logs
          path: build-debug/meson-logs
```
